svg.font-family: 'Visual Anything Roboto', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Control loop
svg.desc:
The loop that moves the arm: the wrist camera sees the part, the grasp policy picks joint targets, the joint controller turns them into torques for the motors, the motors turn the joints, and the encoders read each joint back.
Its long description, an outline of every shape and relation, is in “Pick-and-place arm - Control loop.md”.
